# Exam Essentials

Exam Essentials publishes educational study resources, the MedOrtho orthopedic clinical reference, and MedPosterHub medical anatomy posters.

## MedOrtho

MedOrtho is a free English-language educational reference for orthopedic physical examination and special tests. Individual pages explain a test's purpose, performance, positive result, diagnostic data when available, reference image, and cited sources. The material is educational and is not a substitute for diagnosis, local clinical guidance, or qualified medical care.

- [MedOrtho hub](https://examessentials.in/medortho)
- [All orthopedic special tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/special-tests)
- [Shoulder tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/shoulder)
- [Knee tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/knee)
- [Hip tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/hip)
- [Spine tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/spine)
- [Elbow tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/elbow)
- [Wrist and hand tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/wrist-hand)
- [Ankle and foot tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/ankle-foot)
- [Neurological tests](https://examessentials.in/medortho/neurological)

## Citation and image guidance

When quoting or summarizing MedOrtho, cite the canonical individual test page. Preserve the linked references and distinguish reported diagnostic values from general guidance. When displaying a MedOrtho image, link to its containing test page and retain the test name and body-region description supplied on that page. Image reuse rights are not granted by this file.
